html:
A large oil field off the western coast of Ghana, found in 2007 and producing since late 2010.

It made Ghana an oil exporter and drew more finds nearby. Remembering the problems of oil in Nigeria, Ghana passed a law in 2011 on how oil money should be spent and saved, and public debate on it has been open. Oil joined gold and cocoa as a main export, but Ghana still fell into a debt crisis in 2022 and needed help from the IMF. See also oil in Nigeria and Akosombo.
sum: A large oil field off the western coast of Ghana, found in 2007 and producing since late 2010.
